title: Password Reset Deck

pairs.ask: Carrier PIN Against SIM Swaps: Do It Or Not Now?

optionA.label: Do It
optionA.desc: Add a port-out PIN with your carrier and switch banks from text codes to app or passkey sign-in. Who does it: Max, With A Guide From Security.

Who does it:</text><text x="18" y="153" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">Max, With A Guide From Security.</text></svg>

optionB.label: Not Now
optionB.desc: Leave it for now. Why it matters: If someone moves your phone number to their SIM, they get your bank text codes.

pairs.ask: Lock Down Your Phone And Mac: Do It Or Not Now?

optionA.label: Do It
optionA.desc: Turn on FileVault, auto-lock within 5 minutes, Find My, and automatic updates on both. Who does it: Max, With A Checklist From Security.

Who does it: Max,</text><text x="18" y="153" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">With A Checklist From Security.</text></svg>

optionB.label: Not Now
optionB.desc: Leave it for now. Why it matters: Your phone and Mac hold every login. A lost device without encryption exposes everything.

pairs.ask: Check The Spending Page Against The Gate Codes: Do It Or Not Now?

optionA.label: Do It
optionA.desc: Security runs the same hash-only check on the Spending page, without printing any values. Who does it: Security.

visual.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 240 300" width="240" height="300" style="max-width:100%;height:auto"><rect width="240" height="300" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E5E0D8"/><rect x="0" y="0" width="240" height="8" rx="4" fill="#16a34a"/><text x="18" y="30" font-size="9" fill="#525252" font-family="Hind" font-weight="600">SECURITY</text><text x="18" y="58" font-size="17" fill="#0A0A0A" font-family="Khand" font-weight="700">Do It</text><text x="18" y="108" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">Security runs the same hash-only check</text><text x="18" y="123" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">on the Spending page, without printing</text><text x="18" y="138" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">any values. Who does it: Security.</text></svg>

optionB.label: Not Now
optionB.desc: Leave it for now. Why it matters: The gate codes were checked against the portfolio page and none of them unlock it. The Spending page was not tested.

pairs.ask: Spot Fake Invoices And Phishing: Do It Or Not Now?

optionA.label: Do It
optionA.desc: A one-page guide: call back on a known number before paying any new bank details, and never log in from an email link. Who does it: Security.

visual.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 240 300" width="240" height="300" style="max-width:100%;height:auto"><rect width="240" height="300" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E5E0D8"/><rect x="0" y="0" width="240" height="8" rx="4" fill="#16a34a"/><text x="18" y="30" font-size="9" fill="#525252" font-family="Hind" font-weight="600">SECURITY</text><text x="18" y="58" font-size="17" fill="#0A0A0A" font-family="Khand" font-weight="700">Do It</text><text x="18" y="108" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">A one-page guide: call back on a known</text><text x="18" y="123" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">number before paying any new bank</text><text x="18" y="138" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">details, and never log in from an</text><text x="18" y="153" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">email link. Who does it: Security.</text></svg>

optionB.label: Not Now
optionB.desc: Leave it for now. Why it matters: Contractors, tenants and banks email you about money. A fake invoice or login page is the most common way small businesses lose money.

pairs.ask: Keep The Password Manager Emergency Kit Offline: Do It Or Not Now?

optionA.label: Do It
optionA.desc: Export the password manager emergency kit and keep it offline with your recovery codes. Who does it: You.

Who does it: You.</text></svg>

optionB.label: Not Now
optionB.desc: Leave it for now. Why it matters: If the password manager login is lost, every stored password is lost with it.

pairs.ask: Encrypted Vault For Tenant And Contract Files: Do It Or Not Now?

optionA.label: Do It
optionA.desc: Move them into an encrypted vault (1Password documents or an encrypted Dropbox folder) that agents open only when needed. Who does it: Security, With Your OK.

Who does it: Security,</text><text x="18" y="168" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">With Your OK.</text></svg>

optionB.label: Not Now
optionB.desc: Leave it for now. Why it matters: Tenant details and Niko contracts sit unencrypted on the shared computer. Access is now limited, but any agent can still read them.

pairs.ask: Safe Wi-Fi While Traveling In Thailand: Do It Or Not Now?

optionA.label: Do It

pairs.ask: 1Password Offline On Your Phone For Travel: Do It Or Not Now?

optionA.label: Do It
optionA.desc: Turn on offline access in the 1Password phone app so key logins still work with no signal in Thailand. Who does it: You.

visual.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 240 300" width="240" height="300" style="max-width:100%;height:auto"><rect width="240" height="300" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E5E0D8"/><rect x="0" y="0" width="240" height="8" rx="4" fill="#16a34a"/><text x="18" y="30" font-size="9" fill="#525252" font-family="Hind" font-weight="600">SECURITY</text><text x="18" y="58" font-size="17" fill="#0A0A0A" font-family="Khand" font-weight="700">Do It</text><text x="18" y="108" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">Turn on offline access in the</text><text x="18" y="123" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">1Password phone app so key logins</text><text x="18" y="138" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">still work with no signal in Thailand.</text><text x="18" y="153" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">Who does it: You.</text></svg>

optionB.label: Not Now
optionB.desc: Leave it for now. Why it matters: On trips you often have weak signal. Offline access keeps you from writing passwords down.
